_readme: The town elder. Optional, and that is the point of him: a town's job is to say the same
things the critical path says, in another voice, to a player who wandered.
Node ids, choice count and flag wiring are unchanged from the demo dialogue he used to
speak - promised_elder is still set by the first choice and still read by the kid - so the
three-choice branch and its terminal-node shape stay exactly as tested.

greet.speaker: Elder
greet.text: You came down the north road. Then you have seen the gate, and the woman standing at it.

ask.speaker: Elder
ask.text: Eleven years she has kept a door shut on a building nobody uses. Will you go in for her?

promised.speaker: Elder
promised.text: Then see the smith before you go - she is east along this row, and she keeps something for cuts.

deferred.speaker: Elder
deferred.text: Tomorrow is a fine place to keep things. She has kept it there eleven years.

farewell.speaker: Elder
farewell.text: Go on, then. The hermit east of here has been asking after that keep too.
